answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 6154 Country: CN Title: Upto how much extent (limit) we need to cut our under naval hair means around penis, testis etc? Question: Upto how much extent (limit) we need to cut our under naval hair means around penis, testis etc? Answer ID: 6154 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1032/960=D/1429) One should remove the hair of abdomen below navel, hair on or around penis, testicles and anus. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
